title: Celestial Skyblock
description: A mod pack for hypixel skyblock with QoL
body:
Hypixel Celestial Skyblock – Modpack

Tired of lag, messy menus, and missing out on QoL features while playing Hypixel Skyblock? This pack’s got you covered! 🚀

✨ What’s inside?

⚡ Performance boost – lightweight mods to keep your FPS high and your gameplay smooth.

🎯 Quality of Life upgrades – cleaner menus, quick access to important info, and easier navigation.

🌌 Celestial vibes – a fresh look and feel that makes the grind way more fun.

📊 Smart utilities – track your skills, progress, and coins without the hassle.
